core_claims.name: sameApplications
core_claims.scope: For every pair of naturals, the right-recursive and left-recursive additions give propositionally equal outputs; whole-function equality is not claimed.

core_claims.name: Iso / isoRefl / isoSym / isoTrans
core_claims.scope: Isomorphism of arbitrary types via two maps and both pointwise propositional inverse laws, with reflexivity, symmetry and composition.

core_claims.name: Embedding / embedRefl / embedTrans / isoToEmbedding
core_claims.scope: Retraction-based embeddings of arbitrary types; identity, composition, and forgetting an isomorphism right-inverse law.

core_claims.name: embeddingAntisym
core_claims.scope: Opposed embeddings form an Iso using the first maps when both map/recovery pairs agree pointwise; compatibility hypotheses are explicit.

core_claims.name: binaryEmbedding
core_claims.scope: Embedding of all naturals into unrestricted raw binary strings; only the fromTo inverse is asserted.

core_claims.name: Iff / iffRefl / iffSym / iffTrans
core_claims.scope: Logical equivalence consists of two implications with no inverse laws; equivalence operations are constructed.

deviations: The upstream postulated function extensionality and consequent whole-function addition equality are not assumed. sameApplications preserves the universal pointwise mathematical law.
Embedding map compatibility is pointwise rather than equality of whole functions.
The duplicate datatype presentation and equational DSL are consolidated into named record operations.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: Recorded separately by the primary editor and independent reviewer
